Friday was a strong day for Jaleel's book, with the portfolio sitting at $24,940 and an unrealized gain of $1,680 (+7.23%). The headline mover was Rocket Lab (RKLB), which surged 9.46% to $4,141 — now the largest single position at 16.6% of the book. That's a meaningful concentration in a name flagged AVOID with a QARP of just 39.3, the lowest in the portfolio by a wide margin. The gain feels good; the position sizing does not. Elsewhere, the software rotation lifted ServiceNow (NOW, +6.42%) and Uber (UBER, +6.46%), with the NOW move attributed to sector rotation and pre-Microsoft earnings optimism — sentiment-driven, not fundamental, so treat it accordingly.

The sharpest divergence between price and thesis today was Zoetis (ZTS), which dropped 5.97% to $2,397 — now sitting at a -7.7% loss on cost. That's the worst open loss in the book, yet ZTS carries a STRONG BUY verdict and an 84.6 QARP, the highest in the portfolio. If the fundamentals haven't changed, the price move is an opportunity, not a warning — but that assumption needs to be verified against what actually drove today's selloff. Meanwhile, BSX is nearly flat on the day but carries an elevated risk flag after management guided flat through Q3 following a guidance slash; the thesis is quietly eroding even as price drifts sideways.

To watch heading into next week: RKLB's weight creeping higher on momentum, ZTS's continued pressure against a bullish thesis, and NVDA's earnings on August 26 approaching with export-control noise still live. KO also quietly holds an AVOID verdict — small position, but it's a drag on conviction discipline.

attention.headline: Largest position, lowest quality score, flagged AVOID
attention.note: At 16.6% of the book and a QARP of 39.3 with an AVOID verdict, RKLB's 9.46% pop today has made the concentration problem worse — this is the single biggest risk to a capital-preservation mandate and warrants a sizing decision.

attention.headline: STRONG BUY thesis vs. -5.97% drop and open loss of -7.7%
attention.note: The fundamentals-vs.-price divergence is at its widest today — a 84.6 QARP name with a STRONG BUY verdict is now the book's biggest loser; the cause of today's move needs to be identified to determine whether the thesis still holds or has cracked.

attention.headline: Elevated risk flag: guidance slashed, flat guided through Q3
attention.note: BSX barely moved today (+0.02%) but the underlying story is deteriorating — FY26 growth cut from 10.5% to 7–8.5% with management guiding flat through Q3, yet it still carries a STRONG BUY verdict that may not reflect the new reality.

attention.headline: AVOID-rated position held with no clear thesis
attention.note: Coca-Cola is small ($175) but carries an AVOID verdict and the book's second-lowest QARP (59.6); in a capital-preservation portfolio, holding a name explicitly flagged AVOID — even as a stub — is a discipline question worth answering.
